10flat Law PLLC, Texas, a law firm owned only by licensed attorneys. Our fee is 10% of the total amount recovered at every stage, including trial; case costs and liens are paid from your share after the fee. If there is no recovery, you owe no fee and no case costs. Every case is different, and past results do not guarantee future results. 10flat Law uses software, including AI, and a supervised case team to prepare work; a licensed attorney reviews and approves legal work. The software company, 10flat Technologies, is paid a fixed fee and never shares in a recovery or a fee. Contacting us does not create an attorney-client relationship until a fee agreement is signed. Attorney advertising. Fee comparisons use a one-third (33%) fee, common for Texas injury cases. The calculator is an illustration, not a promise of any outcome.
